title: Overlay Not Forwarding After VTEP Misconfiguration
symptoms: VMs on the same VXLAN VNI on different hosts cannot communicate
Underlay IP connectivity between VTEPs works
The NVE interface is up on both VTEPs
No VXLAN traffic appears in packet captures on either side
rootCause: The VXLAN VNI is mapped to different VLANs on the two VTEPs. On host A, VNI 10000 maps to VLAN 100; on host B, the same VNI maps to VLAN 200. Without matching VLAN-to-VNI mappings, the overlay forwards traffic to the wrong broadcast domain.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the VXLAN VNI-to-VLAN mappings?
steps.hint: Compare mappings on both VTEPs - they must match.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the NVE interface state and peer VTEPs?
steps.hint: Peer VTEPs should be learned via the underlay routing protocol.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the VXLAN configuration in the running-config?
steps.hint: Look for 'member vni X' under each VLAN.
